commands.text: Oh, hello adventurer! Would you like to hear a rumor about the Tower?
They say the higher floors get stranger the further up you climb...
Its a nice day today isnt it?
I wonder why the Road to the City is blocked...
You are a life saver! Thank you! I don't have much but take this with you!
Did you kill those Slimes yet?

Hu? What are you doing here? You look like an Adventurer, can you please help be getting rid of the Slimes east from here? Ever since they started appearing in this Forest, wild Life has started to disappear, which makes my Job as a Hunter very difficult.
